subtitle: Discover our transformation journeys and innovation projects

oaciq_elise.title: Élise - OACIQ Virtual Assistant
oaciq_elise.subtitle: Conversational robot for Quebec real estate brokerage
oaciq_elise.description: Development of an intelligent conversational assistant to accompany real estate brokers and the public in their procedures. Élise answers questions about regulations, buying/selling processes, and guides users to the right OACIQ resources.
oaciq_elise.role: UX designer and conversational experience developer, applying the Calm Magic methodology to create a benevolent and professional interaction.
oaciq_elise.results: 24/7 accessible virtual assistant capable of answering complex regulatory questions, guiding brokers and consumers, and simplifying access to OACIQ services.
oaciq_elise.impact: Significant improvement in accessibility to real estate information for professionals and the public. Reduced waiting time to get answers to common questions.

wuxia_the_fox.title: Wuxia the Fox
wuxia_the_fox.subtitle: Interactive Children's Book & AR Platform
wuxia_the_fox.description: Transmedia educational project launched in Quebec, co-produced with SAGA and public broadcaster TFO. The work takes the form of an illustrated tale associated with an interactive iPad application, combining traditional mythology and modern technologies.
wuxia_the_fox.role: Creator and director of the project, developing augmented narration that mobilizes oral reading and voice recognition.
wuxia_the_fox.results: A 200-page illustrated book with physical modules (masks, wooden blocks to scan) and an iPad app in augmented reality. The device camera recognizes images and symbols from the book to trigger complementary audiovisual animations.
wuxia_the_fox.impact: Funded via successful Kickstarter campaign and published in French and English. Won special mention at Grand Prix Numix 2015 for innovation.

calm_magic_methodology.title: Calm Magic Methodology
calm_magic_methodology.subtitle: Technopoetic Design Framework
calm_magic_methodology.description: Original conceptual framework developed by Jonathan Bélisle to fuse poetry, experience design, and systems thinking in projects. A 'technopoetic' approach aimed at creating transformational digital experiences.
calm_magic_methodology.role: Creator and evangelist of the methodology, applying it across all Paracosm projects.
calm_magic_methodology.results: Comprehensive methodology implemented across all major projects, distinguishing Paracosm's approach in the interactive media landscape.
calm_magic_methodology.impact: Influenced design thinking in Quebec's creative technology sector, providing framework for human-centered innovation.

io_theatre.title: IO Theatre
io_theatre.subtitle: Interactive Spatial Performance
io_theatre.description: Immersive theatrical experience combining live performance with interactive technology. Created an environment where audience members could influence the narrative through their presence and movements.
io_theatre.role: Interactive experience designer and technical director, creating responsive environments that bridge physical and digital realms.
io_theatre.results: Successful interactive theatre production that engaged audiences in new ways, creating memorable and transformative experiences.
io_theatre.impact: Pushed boundaries of traditional theatre, demonstrating new possibilities for audience engagement in performing arts.

simulateur_genial.title: Simulateur Génial
simulateur_genial.subtitle: Educational Simulation Platform
simulateur_genial.description: Interactive learning simulator designed to teach complex concepts through gamification. Developed for educational institutions to enhance student engagement and understanding.
simulateur_genial.role: Lead UX designer and educational technologist, applying learning science principles to create effective educational experiences.
simulateur_genial.results: Successfully deployed educational platform used by thousands of students, improving learning outcomes and engagement.
simulateur_genial.impact: Enhanced educational experiences for students and provided teachers with powerful tools for instruction.

naissance_du_monde.title: Naissance du Monde
naissance_du_monde.subtitle: Public Art Installation
naissance_du_monde.description: Large-scale public art installation exploring themes of creation and transformation. Combined traditional artistic techniques with modern technology to create an immersive public experience.
naissance_du_monde.role: Lead artist and technical coordinator, bridging artistic vision with technical implementation.
naissance_du_monde.results: Successful public art installation that became a landmark, engaging thousands of visitors and creating lasting cultural impact.
naissance_du_monde.impact: Transformed public space into interactive cultural destination, fostering community engagement and artistic appreciation.

lachine_passages.title: Lachine Passages
lachine_passages.subtitle: Historical Interactive Installation
lachine_passages.description: Interactive installation celebrating the history of Lachine, Quebec. Created immersive experiences that brought historical narratives to life through modern technology.
lachine_passages.role: Creative director and experience designer, translating historical research into engaging interactive experiences.
lachine_passages.results: Engaging historical installation that educated visitors about local heritage while providing memorable interactive experiences.
lachine_passages.impact: Preserved and celebrated local history, creating new connections between community and heritage.

machine_bienveillance.title: La Machine à Bienveillance
machine_bienveillance.subtitle: NFB interactive installation — kindness vs. incivility
machine_bienveillance.description: Immersive installation co-produced with the National Film Board of Canada, presented at MURAL (Montréal, 2017) and toured to Europe, notably Brussels in 2019 as part of the Brux'ils Brux'elles festival (Recyclart). A monumental pink surveillance-camera sculpture flips the script of control: instead of watching over people, it 'watches over them with kindness' — dialogue, compliments and micro-gestures of civility offered to passers-by.
machine_bienveillance.role: Experience designer and conversational interaction designer, working with the NFB interactive team on the dialogue dramaturgy, the choreography of kindness gestures and the scripting of public encounters.

methods.0: Situated interaction design in public space

machine_bienveillance.results: Thousands of public interactions in Montréal and Brussels, press coverage (Le Soir), documentation and distribution by the NFB, and an academic study published in the journal Communication (OpenEdition).
machine_bienveillance.impact: Reframes the technological gaze: surveillance becomes a vector of social connection rather than control. The work fed public debate on urban incivility and on what a relational intelligence could look like in public space.

banff_residence.title: Banff Creative Residence
banff_residence.subtitle: Mountain Innovation Lab
banff_residence.description: Artist residency at Banff Centre focused on exploring the intersection of nature, technology, and creative practice. Developed new methodologies for creative technology work.
banff_residence.role: Resident artist and researcher, exploring new frontiers in creative technology and nature-inspired design.
banff_residence.results: Groundbreaking research in nature-technology integration, leading to new creative methodologies and artistic practices.
banff_residence.impact: Advanced understanding of how natural environments can inspire and inform creative technology practices.

tedx_montreal.title: TEDx Montreal
tedx_montreal.subtitle: Technology and Human Connection
tedx_montreal.description: Keynote presentation at TEDx Montreal exploring the future of human-technology relationships. Shared insights on creating more meaningful connections in the digital age.
tedx_montreal.role: Keynote speaker and thought leader, sharing vision for humanized technology and meaningful digital experiences.
tedx_montreal.results: Inspiring talk that reached thousands of viewers and influenced thinking about technology's role in human connection.
tedx_montreal.impact: Contributed to important conversations about the future of human-technology relationships and digital wellness.
